question: Which compound did FTIR suggest forms as a unique component of the 300 °C–300 °C multilayer urea crystal, and in what temperature range does TGA show the extra mass-loss step attributed to it?
rendered: Cyanuric acid (CYA) forms as a unique component of the 300 °C–300 °C multilayer urea crystal. The extra mass-loss step attributed to CYA, as shown by TGA, occurs within the temperature range of 200–250 °C.
